Check Engine SEO 1.3.166

**Check Engine is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, and the most important problem in full with its fix. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes) to see all the others, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *A short welcome tour the first time you open it.* Six plain steps show how to enter a website, run the audit, read your score and the fix plan, share a PDF and unlock the full version. Skip it any time, and open it again from the round ? button at the top of the window ("Take the tour").
- *Your activations are safer.* Opening Check Engine twice at the same moment can no longer use two of your three activations. If the computer cannot save the activation, it hands the activation straight back instead of keeping it. If an activation was released from another computer, this one gets a new one automatically instead of saying your key is wrong.
- *A clearer message when the licence server is slow to answer.* It now says what to do next: wait a minute and reopen, or write to us from checkengineseo.com and we release any activation that was taken by mistake.
- *"Everything, however big it is" says what it does.* It said it stops after 15 minutes, but with no page limit it runs for up to a day. The wording now says one day.
- *"Keep it private" names the fifth skipped check correctly.* It is the refresh of Check Engine's crawler and speed knowledge, not the app's own update check.
- *The free result shows the current offer.* If the offer could not be fetched when Check Engine started, it asks again, so the sale line is not missing for the whole session.
- Nothing else changed in how audits, reports or licences work. Your licence key, settings and past reports carry over as before.

99 checks across 13 areas.
